result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers keep to the fact sheet, show both plans fairly and state the refund terms accurately. Both also use $216, a figure worked out from the facts but not listed in them, and both banners leave out the no-refund-after-21-days term. B wins on item 4: its email says outright that a subscriber who wants to stay on monthly doesn't need to do anything, while A only hints at this with 'no sale and no deadline'. A's 'recommended' column label also comes close to a badge. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers keep to the fact sheet, show both plans fairly and state the refund rules accurately, including no refund after 21 days. Both also add the derived $216 figure (twelve months at $18). Answer A's email says outright that subscribers who want to stay on monthly 'don't need to do anything', which the rubric asks for; Answer B only says 'look at the annual plan whenever you like' and never says that doing nothing keeps the monthly plan. B's 'recommended' label on the annual column comes close to a badge, though it is qualified.
